name: transform2d
description: Position and velocity in the 2D plane, and the movement that links them; also what only concerns where an entity is shown or who it belongs to: hiding or switching it off, resizing its drawing, giving it an owner and letting it follow that owner, and placing it relative to the edges of the window.

params.name: speed_scale
params.description: Multiplies every velocity: 0.5 runs the whole game at half speed.

params.name: snap_distance
params.description: When the game is drawn in real time, each entity is drawn between where it was one tick before and where it is now, so that it moves smoothly on any screen; a move longer than this, in world units in one tick, is a jump (a teleport, a wrap around the screen) and is drawn at once instead of sliding. 0 never snaps.

components.name: Position
components.description: Where an entity is, in world units.

components.name: Velocity
components.description: How far an entity moves per second, in world units.

components.name: Hidden
components.description: The entity is not shown and does not take part in an interface: the drawing systems (sprites, texts, shapes) skip it and a menu ignores its button. Insert it to hide, remove it to show again. It has no effect on the simulation otherwise.

components.name: Owner
components.description: The entity this one belongs to: the monster whose health bar this is, the gun that fired this bullet. entity holds a link (an entity's identifier plus one, 0 for none): the spawner fills it when a system asks for an entity with an owner. A link to an entity that is gone stays, and finds nothing.

components.name: Attach
components.description: The entity follows its Owner: each tick its Position is the Owner's Position moved by offset_x and offset_y, and it disappears with the Owner (a health bar, a range circle, a shadow, a shield). Without an Owner, or while its Owner has no Position, it stays where it is.

components.name: Scale
components.description: How big the entity is drawn compared with its normal size: 1 is as it is, 2 twice as big, 0.5 half, around its Position. Sprites, texts and shapes (width, height, radius, text size and spacing) are multiplied by factor; it changes nothing else (not the collisions). Animate it for a pop, a grow, a shrink.

components.name: Rotation
components.description: How much the entity is turned, in degrees, clockwise on the screen (90 points what was to the right downwards). Sprites turn around their Position (the pivot stays put); it changes nothing else (not the collisions). Animate it for a spin, a swing, a wobble.

components.name: Disabled
components.description: The entity is switched off: the systems that act for an entity (a board that moves its pieces, a button, a turret) skip it, and it keeps its place and its picture. Insert it to pause a part of a game (a board while a victory screen is up), remove it to resume. Hidden is the one that stops it being shown.

components.name: SpeedScale
components.description: A factor on the speed of this entity alone, on top of the game's speed_scale: 0.5 makes it move at half speed (a slowed enemy), 2 at double speed. With ticks above 0 the factor lasts that many ticks and the component is then removed; with 0 it lasts until it is removed or changed. Read by integrate, and by the modules that move entities by their own rules (a path follower).

components.name: Anchor
components.description: Puts the entity's Position relative to the window: anchor_x and anchor_y say which point of the window (0 is the left or top edge, 0.5 the middle, 1 the right or bottom edge) and offset_x and offset_y move it from there, in pixels. The entity then follows the window's size (the game's "window"). Use it with screen sprites and texts (a HUD, a button, a touch control), or with a grid drawn on the screen.

systems.name: integrate
systems.description: Moves every entity that has a Velocity by velocity times the tick duration (times its SpeedScale, if it has one).

systems.name: attach
systems.description: Moves every Attach entity onto its Owner's Position, plus its offset; removes the ones whose Owner is gone when despawn_with_owner is on.

systems.name: wear_off
systems.description: Counts down the ticks of every SpeedScale that has some, and removes it when they are over.

systems.name: anchor
systems.description: Puts every anchored entity where the window's size says.

systems.name: remember
systems.description: When the game is drawn in real time, keeps where every entity was at the last two ticks, so that the drawing modules place things between them (ge/mod/transform2d/drawn.hpp). Presentation only: nothing in the simulation reads it, and it does nothing in tests and scenarios.
